App details

Compass & Altimeter

Check direction, coordinates and altitude using the sensors available on your phone.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

A practical aid for checking direction and height outdoors. Magnetic direction comes from the phone’s sensors; true north is shown only when reliable location and magnetic correction data are available. GPS and barometric altitude stay clearly distinguished, with quality information.

Main features

  • Magnetic north and, with reliable data, true north.
  • Choose from five coordinate formats and copy them.
  • Separate GPS and barometric altitude readings.
  • See the data source, quality and available accuracy.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Use the compass for magnetic direction and check its quality warning near metal or magnets. Select true north only when reliable location and magnetic correction are available. Copy coordinates in one of five formats. In the altitude view, compare clearly labelled GPS and barometer readings; set known reference pressure or height and use Relative Zero.

Important limits

A phone is not a certified navigation or surveying instrument. GPS altitude and barometric estimates are different sources. Missing sensors or denied location leave only the available functions active.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Location is requested for coordinates, GPS altitude and true-north correction while using those functions. Magnetic compass and available barometer functions can work without it; no background location is planned.

Local data

North mode, coordinate format and barometer references would be local settings. Current coordinates and sensor samples are temporary; no route or location history is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

No map navigation, waypoint storage, journey tracking or altitude history is included.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
